source_method: Built-in image generation expanded the reviewed three-panel geography into a higher-resolution authored master; EVAVO registration removed review gutters and produced three native 640x1024 panels. The deterministic build performs seam finishing, palette preservation and runtime export without enlargement.

rules: Recognizable geography never repeats at the former 720-pixel plate interval.
Every coast panel enters the build at its final 640-pixel runtime width; the builder may not upscale an undersized background plate.
Low-altitude native captures must preserve crisp road markings, concrete joints, rock clusters and wave detail without softness or horizontally stretched structures.
Animated water and atmosphere never bake into the geography chunks.
Finite structures use role-registered land and shore slots with a different cycle from geography; seed variation may jitter position but never substitute an incompatible asset.
All adjacent chunk boundaries share a zero-error scanline contract derived from the two local natural edges.
No broad shared connector or blurred horizontal strip may be stamped across the chunk interiors.
